_about: Known architectural debt. Each entry is a finding the audit reports without failing. A NEW finding fails; an entry that no longer matches a finding is STALE and fails too, so paid debt must be removed here. Never add an entry without a reason, and prefer fixing the code to adding one. See tools/audit/audit.py.

accepted.reason: The Python bindings build their own registry and a Memory/Tiered/Ddc cache, with no mesh cache and no DDC blob tier -- the same drift Controller and Session had, and the copy the DocumentRuntime extraction (8ed1262, 5de7fa8) missed. Move Session onto cad::runtime::DocumentRuntime; pytest in CI covers the result.
